character_facts: The central female warrior has a replication or swarm-division ability.
Her duplicates appear visually identical and humanoid.
She is explicitly described as a warrior.
An observing speaker is frightened or overwhelmed by the display.
characters_present: Unnamed female warrior who can split into duplicates
At least two unseen or off-panel speakers in the final panel
Several armored observers/soldiers seen from behind
continuity_links: This page functions as an explanation or demonstration of a previously introduced warrior's powers.
The armored viewers suggest the duplication is being observed, reported, or recounted to others in-story.
dialogue_meaning: The page counts the warrior's multiplication upward from two to larger numbers.
One speaker reacts with alarm and describes the sight as a nightmare.
Another speaker explains that the woman was a warrior with the ability to divide into millions of insect-like units, devastate an entire planet, and then re-form into one self.
locations: An enclosed chamber or arena where the duplication occurs
A futuristic interior/platform with open view to space in the final panel
lore_facts: This setting includes beings or technologies capable of a humanoid body splitting into multiple identical bodies.
The warrior's multiplication is described as comparable to a human-form insect swarm.
The swarm ability is said to scale from a single individual to potentially millions of units.
The swarm can later recombine into one individual body.
The ability is described as powerful enough to waste an entire planet.
plot_events: A female warrior begins physically dividing, first shown at the face level.
Her body separates into two figures.
The duplication continues into larger numbers, culminating in many identical warriors present at once.
Armored observers or soldiers witness the multiplying figures.
Expository dialogue explains that she could disperse into a vast swarm and later reform as a single individual.
uncertainties: The warrior's name is not given on this page.
The identities of the speakers in the final panel are not visible.
Some dialogue is small and partially difficult to read precisely, so wording may be slightly approximate.
It is unclear whether the multiplication is happening live, being remembered, or being explained over a separate establishing shot in the last panel.
visual_summary: A female warrior-like figure is shown splitting apart in stages. The top panel shows her face dividing into two contrasting halves, one more organic or patterned and one dark-haired humanlike half. The next panels depict her body duplicating from one into two, then more copies forming. A wider panel shows the multiplication continuing into a line of many identical figures while armored onlookers face them. The final panel shifts to an interior or platform-like setting in space, where off-panel or unseen speakers explain that this warrior could divide into a swarm and later recombine.
